tracker_title: Cure LFP Series — Missing Documentation & Issues Tracker
case_summary: Kit Carson County COC members Brad Cure, Eric Cure, and Denis & Victoria Cure filed six CCC-853 LFP applications (2020 and 2021 crop years, two applications per producer per year — three producers × two years = six total). STC action required under 1-LFP Par. 4A because the applicants are COC members. Attorney Byrd represents the appellants. Any STC denial will be appealed to NAD; any STC approval will be scrutinized as COC-member favoritism. Record must be airtight either direction.

legal_issues: LATE FILING — 5 years, 10 months after trigger. Independent grounds for denial absent documented FSA misaction.

RISK-AND-CONTROL — 1-LFP Par. 26 requires 'control, however limited' with some evidence in record. Cancelled checks explicitly rejected as substitute per STO's own DR. 8 farms have no lease and no CCC-855.
LIVESTOCK ELIGIBILITY — 500-lb-on-trigger-date requirement. Bank B/S 198 days post-trigger cannot establish presence or weight on 6/16/20.
WHEAT HRW CATEGORICAL — Long-Season Small Grain non-trigger is a national-level determination under 7 CFR 1416. STC has no authority to override; NAD will affirm.

applications.safe_middle_posture: Approve 495 head (275 + 220, the contemporaneous COC-approved number). Approve F1740 (30 ac confirmed). Deny the 8 risk-control-missing farms absent new Byrd evidence. Deny Wheat HRW categorically. F7488 (2020) — approve if FSA-578 supports continuity of control, otherwise deny.

cross_cutting_issues.topic: Wheat HRW 2020 Categorically Ineligible for Kit Carson
cross_cutting_issues.detail: Long-Season Small Grain did NOT trigger for Kit Carson County in 2020. Wheat HRW is categorically ineligible for 2020 LFP regardless of lease, livestock, or any other factor. This is a national-level LSSG trigger determination under 7 CFR 1416 that STC has no authority to override. NAD will affirm.
cross_cutting_issues.stc_minute_language_recommended: '2020 Wheat HRW acreage denied per national LSSG trigger determination for Kit Carson County; STC has no authority to override.'
cross_cutting_issues.action_needed: Apply uniformly to all three 2020 applications (Brad, Eric, Denis & Victoria). Verify 2021 Kit Carson LSSG status before applying to 2021 applications.

cross_cutting_issues.detail: Brad Cure 2020 CCC-853 signed 5/5/26 and received by FSA 5/12/26 — 5 years, 10 months after the 6/16/20 trigger. Other applications presumably filed around the same time (May 2026). Late filing is not automatically fatal but requires documented reason in record.
defensible_late_file_reasons: Documented FSA misaction (county office refused to accept application in 2020-2021)
Documented FSA misinformation (incorrect eligibility guidance given to producer)
Previously-filed application denied in error, current filing is re-submission
cross_cutting_issues.action_needed: Byrd brief most likely addresses this. If no documented reason in record, late-filing itself is independent grounds for denial.
